codes.message: Selected file belongs to more than one executable target.
codes.requiredRemediation: Select an explicit target or project target config.

codes.message: Selected file does not match any known executable target.
codes.requiredRemediation: Select a target whose source set contains the entry file.

codes.message: Build metadata is unavailable for the selected target.
codes.requiredRemediation: Provide compile_commands.json, CMake File API replies, or explicit project target config.

codes.message: Target identity was selected from explicit project configuration.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required; keep the explicit target config fresh.

codes.message: Target identity was selected from CMake File API codemodel metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required; refresh CMake File API replies after build graph changes.

codes.message: Target identity was derived from compile_commands.json without CMake target ownership metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: Provide CMake File API replies or explicit target config for stronger target ownership.

codes.message: Target identity used an inferred fallback because stronger build metadata was unavailable.
codes.requiredRemediation: Provide compile_commands.json, CMake File API replies, or explicit target config.

codes.message: Compiler dependency scan evidence was attached to target metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required unless the dependency scan hash is stale.

codes.message: Toolchain probe evidence was attached to target metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required unless the toolchain probe hash is stale.

codes.message: Runtime probe evidence was attached to target metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required unless the runtime probe hash is stale.

codes.message: Generated header content evidence was attached to target metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required unless generated headers changed.

codes.message: Link and runtime library resolution evidence was attached to target metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required unless link/runtime roots changed.

codes.message: Selected target configuration could not be converted into safe workspace-relative identity material.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh build metadata or provide explicit workspace-relative target config.

codes.message: The build system is not modeled well enough to produce a selected target identity.
codes.requiredRemediation: Provide explicit project target config or supported CMake/compile_commands metadata.

codes.message: CMake File API replies were not available.
codes.requiredRemediation: Configure the CMake build directory with File API query files when target ambiguity exists.

codes.message: CMake File API replies could not be parsed into target metadata.
codes.requiredRemediation: Regenerate CMake File API replies from a clean configure step.

codes.message: CMake File API replies did not include a codemodel object.
codes.requiredRemediation: Create a codemodel-v2 query and rerun CMake configure.

codes.message: CMake File API codemodel did not expose selectable targets.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh the CMake build directory or provide explicit target config.

codes.message: Vulkan GPU HMR is unsupported without modeled context, swapchain, descriptor, and synchronization ownership.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use an explicitly supported render path or run diagnostics only.

codes.message: The project shape is unsupported for GPU HMR generation.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use diagnostics to identify the unsupported build, render, or device topology.

codes.message: AI split output could not be parsed into the required generated-role response shape.
codes.requiredRemediation: Retry within the bounded split/repair loop or fall back to diagnostics.

codes.message: Generated split output did not include the required device role.
codes.requiredRemediation: Repair generated artifacts only and rerun schema verification.

codes.message: AI provider timed out before producing a verifier-gated proposal.
codes.requiredRemediation: Retry within budget or choose a non-agentic fallback.

codes.message: AI provider failed before producing a verifier-gated proposal.
codes.requiredRemediation: Retry if provider state allows or choose a deterministic fallback.

codes.message: AI provider rejected generation due to rate limits.
codes.requiredRemediation: Retry after backoff or choose a deterministic fallback.

codes.message: AI provider is unavailable or overloaded.
codes.requiredRemediation: Retry when provider health recovers or choose a deterministic fallback.

codes.message: Generated host code still contains a raw GPU kernel launch.
codes.requiredRemediation: Route generated launch sites through the Synthi GPU launch boundary.

codes.message: Generated code bypasses the launch indirection boundary.
codes.requiredRemediation: Route all reloadable launch sites through the stable launch table wrapper.

codes.message: Generated role owns symbol lookup that should belong to the loader.
codes.requiredRemediation: Move dlsym/GetProcAddress/vendor module lookup behind the loader boundary.

codes.message: Toolchain capability profile is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Derive a selected-target capability profile before allowing device_only or warm_rebuild.

codes.message: Toolchain capability profile is stale for the selected target or flags.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh toolchain probes and effective flags before unsafe fast paths.

codes.message: Kernel signature changed and device_only reload is unsafe.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use ABI-changing fallback or regenerate affected roles through verifier gates.

codes.message: Constant or global device symbol layout changed.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use ABI-changing fallback or regenerate affected roles through verifier gates.

codes.message: Reload could leave a stale launch pointer active.
codes.requiredRemediation: Regenerate roles to use verified launch indirection before promotion.

codes.message: Stale launch pointer verification did not run.
codes.requiredRemediation: Run launch indirection verification before allowing reload.

codes.message: Compiler-derived template evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Collect fresh template evidence before warm_rebuild of template-dependent edits.

codes.message: Compiler-derived template evidence is stale.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh template evidence for the selected target and effective flags.

codes.message: Template instantiation impact is unbounded.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use AI delta, full resplit, or unsupported fallback; do not use direct device_only.

codes.message: Header dependency impact is unbounded.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use bounded warm rebuild only after dependency evidence is available.

codes.message: Warm rebuild exceeded the configured latency budget.
codes.requiredRemediation: Ask developer consent or choose a cheaper fallback.

codes.message: Device-link path is linker-bound and not a hot HMR path.
codes.requiredRemediation: Ask developer consent or choose a clearer fallback.

codes.message: RDC device-link estimate exceeds budget.
codes.requiredRemediation: Ask developer consent or isolate hot kernels to avoid linker-bound reloads.

codes.message: Selected toolchain does not support modeled incremental device linking.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use full rebuild/relink or unsupported fallback for this topology.

codes.message: AI delta would touch multiple generated roles.
codes.requiredRemediation: Ask developer consent before applying the multi-role transaction.

codes.message: Selected fallback may lose runner state.
codes.requiredRemediation: Ask developer consent before cold restart or state-losing fallback.

codes.message: GPU device or preview session is tainted by a suspected driver fault.
codes.requiredRemediation: Restart the runner/session or reset the device before accepting screenshots as proof.

codes.message: GPU driver timeout or reset marker was detected.
codes.requiredRemediation: Treat the session as tainted and require recovery before continuing.

codes.message: Screenshot verifier did not capture a visible frame.
codes.requiredRemediation: Do not mark runtime verification passed until a visible frame is captured.

codes.message: Arbiter selected a path that requires developer consent.
codes.requiredRemediation: Request consent or select a non-disruptive fallback.

codes.message: Multiple device translation units require explicit topology verification.
codes.requiredRemediation: Model per-TU compile and device-link topology before device_only reload.

codes.message: A referenced include could not be resolved.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh dependency evidence or add the missing header to target metadata.

codes.message: GPU HMR request payload is valid JSON but violates the split-broker contract.
codes.requiredRemediation: Send the required identity fields for the requested GPU HMR operation.

codes.message: A mutating GPU HMR request did not include an idempotency key.
codes.requiredRemediation: Retry with an idempotency key derived from the workspace, operation, and identity hash.

codes.message: The idempotency key was reused for different GPU HMR identity material.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use a new idempotency key when the operation input changes.

codes.message: The requested target-scoped projection does not exist.
codes.requiredRemediation: Create or refresh the projection for the selected target identity.

codes.message: Projection identity material does not match the referenced source, target, CodeIntel, or build metadata generation.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh the projection with matching CodeIntel and build metadata identities.

codes.message: The requested GPU HMR candidate does not exist.
codes.requiredRemediation: Prepare a candidate from a fresh projection before verification or promotion.

codes.message: The candidate has no immutable candidate spec manifest.
codes.requiredRemediation: Complete broker-issued generation and produce a candidate spec manifest before verification.

codes.message: The supplied candidate spec manifest hash does not match the candidate resource.
codes.requiredRemediation: Fetch the candidate again and verify the current immutable manifest hash.

codes.message: The candidate has no verification record for promotion.
codes.requiredRemediation: Run deterministic verification and use the returned verification record hash.

codes.message: The supplied candidate verification record hash does not match the candidate state.
codes.requiredRemediation: Fetch the latest candidate verification record before promotion.

codes.message: A deterministic verifier could not prove the candidate safe.
codes.requiredRemediation: Inspect verifier reports, repair the candidate, and rerun verification.

codes.message: The candidate references a stale source split identity or source generation.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh projection and candidate scope after the source or CodeIntel generation changes.

codes.message: The candidate references a stale CodeIntel generation.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh CodeIntel and rebuild the target-scoped projection.

codes.message: The candidate references stale retrieval identity material.
codes.requiredRemediation: Regenerate role packages with current retrieval identities.

codes.message: Candidate verification or generation was cancelled.
codes.requiredRemediation: Prepare a fresh candidate or resume only after referenced identities still match.

codes.message: The workspace branch changed while the candidate was in progress.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh source identities on the current branch and prepare a new candidate.

codes.message: The selected build directory changed while the candidate was in progress.
codes.requiredRemediation: Refresh build metadata and prepare a candidate for the current build directory.

codes.message: Another GPU HMR promotion transaction is active for the workspace.
codes.requiredRemediation: Wait for the active promotion transaction to finish, then retry with current identities.

codes.message: Required deterministic verifier proof is unavailable.
codes.requiredRemediation: Run the concrete verifier that produces the required compile, dependency, ABI, or runtime proof.

codes.message: The requested GPU HMR job does not exist.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use the job ID returned by the projection, candidate, verification, or diagnostics operation.

codes.message: The requested GPU HMR job can no longer be cancelled.
codes.requiredRemediation: Inspect the completed job trace and prepare a new operation if needed.

codes.message: A generated artifact path was absolute.
codes.requiredRemediation: Write generated artifacts only under the broker-owned candidate directory.

codes.message: A generated artifact path escaped the workspace or candidate directory.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use workspace-relative generated paths inside the broker-owned candidate directory.

codes.message: A generated artifact path resolved through a symlink outside the allowed candidate directory.
codes.requiredRemediation: Remove symlink escapes and regenerate artifacts under the broker-owned candidate directory.

codes.message: Generated artifact paths collide on a case-insensitive filesystem.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use unique generated paths that do not collide under the workspace filesystem policy.

codes.message: Generated build metadata attempted to add a command or post-build action outside the broker contract.
codes.requiredRemediation: Remove generated commands and keep generation inside declared role artifact files.

codes.message: No fission candidate was provided for deterministic verification.
codes.requiredRemediation: Provide at least one fission island candidate with verifier evidence.

codes.message: At least one fission candidate passed deterministic verification.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required; use the selected verified candidate.

codes.message: The fission candidate passed deterministic verifier gates.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required; keep proof artifacts attached to the candidate.

codes.message: All fission candidates were rejected by deterministic verification.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use the verifier reason codes to repair candidates or select a wider proven scope.

codes.message: A fission candidate was not a structured object.
codes.requiredRemediation: Return a structured fission candidate object that matches the verifier contract.

codes.message: The fission island id is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach a stable island id derived from deterministic candidate identity.

codes.message: The source edit id is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the source edit id covered by the fission candidate.

codes.message: The candidate artifact kind is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Declare the artifact kind using the generic fission scope vocabulary.

codes.message: The candidate artifact kind is not recognized by the generic fission verifier.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use a supported generic artifact scope or provide deterministic verifier support for a new scope.

codes.message: The dependency closure hash is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Compute and attach the dependency closure hash from deterministic dependency evidence.

codes.message: The dependency closure hash is not a valid sha256 digest.
codes.requiredRemediation: Recompute the dependency closure hash from verifier-owned inputs.

codes.message: The ABI membrane id is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the ABI membrane id proven by deterministic ABI extraction.

codes.message: The compile recipe hash is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the compile recipe hash for the selected fission island.

codes.message: The compile recipe hash is not a valid sha256 digest.
codes.requiredRemediation: Recompute the compile recipe hash from verifier-owned inputs.

codes.message: The compile command hash is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the compile command hash for the selected fission island.

codes.message: The compile command hash is not a valid sha256 digest.
codes.requiredRemediation: Recompute the compile command hash from verifier-owned inputs.

codes.message: The replacement scope is not recognized by the generic fission verifier.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use a supported generic replacement scope.

codes.message: The artifact scope is not recognized by the generic fission verifier.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use a supported generic artifact scope.

codes.message: The fission scope is not recognized by the generic fission verifier.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use a supported generic fission scope.

codes.message: The declared replacement scope is narrower than the artifact kind can prove.
codes.requiredRemediation: Align the replacement scope with the artifact kind or provide a narrower verified artifact.

codes.message: The candidate source paths are missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach workspace-relative source paths covered by the fission island.

codes.message: The candidate source spans are missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach source spans that map to the declared source paths.

codes.message: The target symbols are missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the target symbols owned by the fission island.

codes.message: The expected exported symbols are missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the expected artifact export set and symbol ownership evidence.

codes.message: Verifier evidence ids are missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic verifier evidence ids for the fission candidate.

codes.message: A source path is not workspace-relative or escapes the workspace.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use normalized workspace-relative source paths.

codes.message: The generated role path required for this fission scope is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the verifier-owned generated role path or choose a source-only scope.

codes.message: The generated role path is not workspace-relative or escapes the workspace.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use a normalized workspace-relative generated role path.

codes.message: The candidate has no deterministic verifier evidence.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach verifier-owned evidence; AI or model evidence cannot certify the candidate.

codes.message: Source mapping evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic source mapping evidence for the candidate spans.

codes.message: Include closure evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic include closure evidence for the candidate.

codes.message: Symbol ownership evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic symbol ownership evidence for target and exported symbols.

codes.message: Dependency closure evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic dependency closure evidence for the candidate.

codes.message: ABI membrane evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach accepted ABI extractor evidence for the candidate membrane.

codes.message: ABI membrane verification did not pass.
codes.requiredRemediation: Run the ABI verifier with accepted extractor provenance before publishing the candidate.

codes.message: Compile recipe evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic compile recipe evidence for the candidate artifact.

codes.message: Loader capability evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic evidence for the required loader capability and transport.

codes.message: Output oracle evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic output oracle evidence or a required oracle contract.

codes.message: A source span is malformed.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach valid line or byte spans mapped to workspace-relative source paths.

codes.message: A source span path is not included in the declared source paths.
codes.requiredRemediation: Normalize source span paths and ensure each is covered by the candidate source path set.

codes.message: The include closure is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach an explicit include closure, even if it is empty.

codes.message: An include closure entry is malformed or escapes the workspace.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach normalized workspace-relative include closure entries.

codes.message: The loader capability requirement is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Declare the required artifact loader capability and transport.

codes.message: The loader capability requirement is invalid.
codes.requiredRemediation: Use a supported generic loader transport or provide deterministic support for a new transport.

codes.message: The candidate has no deterministic output oracle contract.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach a required oracle id or a valid inline output oracle proposal.

codes.message: The output oracle proposal is incomplete or uses an unaccepted oracle kind.
codes.requiredRemediation: Provide an accepted deterministic oracle with expected value, producer, output target, session binding, artifact binding, and readback contract.

codes.message: A target symbol is not in the expected exported symbol set.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach symbol identity mapping evidence or correct the candidate export set.

codes.message: The candidate exports extra symbols without deterministic safety evidence.
codes.requiredRemediation: Provide a safe export superset reason and deterministic evidence, or narrow the artifact.

codes.message: The candidate is wider than the narrowest scope without complete narrower-rejection evidence.
codes.requiredRemediation: Record deterministic rejection reasons and evidence for narrower scopes or provide a narrower candidate.

codes.message: Original host path mapping is required but missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the original host launch mapping id or select a scope that does not require original host path attachment.

codes.message: Original host path mapping evidence is missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic evidence for the original host launch mapping.

codes.message: Original host path attachment requires runtime instrumentation or proven attachment evidence.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach a complete instrumentation proposal or runtime-proven original host attachment evidence.

codes.message: Stream ordering evidence is required but missing.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach deterministic stream ordering evidence for the affected dispatch path.

codes.message: Epoch retirement evidence is required but unavailable.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach retirement fence evidence or mark the candidate degraded to a conservative synchronization strategy.

codes.message: An AI-proposed candidate is missing its AI proposal id.
codes.requiredRemediation: Attach the AI proposal id so deterministic promotion can be audited.

codes.message: An AI-proposed candidate has not been promoted by deterministic verifier evidence.
codes.requiredRemediation: Run deterministic verification and attach promotion evidence before accepting the candidate.

codes.message: A function-body fission island was rejected because the edit crosses the body boundary.
codes.requiredRemediation: Select a wider generic fission scope or provide a narrower candidate with source-span proof.

codes.message: A narrow fission island was rejected because include closure evidence is unavailable.
codes.requiredRemediation: Collect include closure evidence or select a wider generic fission scope.

codes.message: A narrow fission island was rejected because symbol ownership is ambiguous.
codes.requiredRemediation: Collect symbol ownership evidence or select a wider generic fission scope.

codes.message: A narrower scope was rejected because the runtime artifact selection did not materialize it.
codes.requiredRemediation: Materialize the narrower artifact with deterministic evidence or select the proven wider artifact.

codes.message: Prompt-like text in source comments was ignored in favor of the broker-issued role package.
codes.requiredRemediation: No remediation required unless the broker package itself is stale.
